responsibility: This definition file enumerates the primitive, pointer, fixed-arity function, and variadic function tree types that the Fortran front end needs when declaring builtins and runtime/helper entry points. It is a Fortran-specific subset of GCC’s builtin-types definitions, consumed through DEF_* macros to generate stable type tables for atomic operations, OpenMP helpers, and other frontend-declared builtins without hardcoding each tree type construction in C++.
